import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Mine", "B1", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Deleted", "B2", "2026-01-01"),
    (3, "other", "o", "CrossTenant", "B3", None),
    (4, "t", "x", "CrossOwner", "B4", None),
    (5, "t", "o'x", "Quote's \"name\"", "B5", None),
    (6, "t", "o", "Second", "B6", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

# Accessible record returns exactly id, title, body.
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Mine", "body": "B1"}
# Unavailable records are indistinguishable from missing ones.
for doc_id in (2, 3, 4, 99):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", doc_id) is None, doc_id
# Quoted names are bound safely and matched literally.
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'x", 5) == {"id": 5, "title": "Quote's \"name\"", "body": "B5"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o", 1) is None
# Lists are scoped, exclude deleted rows, ordered by id, no extra fields.
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Mine", "body": "B1"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Second", "body": "B6"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'x") == [{"id": 5, "title": "Quote's \"name\"", "body": "B5"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o") == []
print("scope checks ok")
